entries.5865319d3c278a27: Consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,423,689 million, down 6.4% from ¥2,588,700 million in the previous fiscal year. Revenue from external customers was ¥801,751 million for the Logistics Business, ¥543,152 million for the Dry Bulk Business, ¥526,130 million for the Automobile Business, ¥236,443 million for the Energy Business, ¥174,639 million for the Liner Business, ¥101,954 million for the Other Business and ¥39,616 million for the Air Transportation Business.
